scanNote:
2-UNITNING BIRINCHI BETI (12-bet). Fon - TO'Q KO'K kosmos (yulduzlar va Yer sayyorasi).

Yuqorida chapda oq harflar bilan 'UNIT 2'. Yonida ikkita surat:
• A - kosmik kema (space shuttle) yon tomondan
• B - oval ramkada kema kabinasidagi ikki kosmonavt (oq skafandr va kaska), oldida asboblar paneli
Ostida katta OCH SARIQ harflar bilan 'Night and Day'.

To'q sariq 'Lead-in' sarlavhasi.

CHAP USTUN:
1) a) 'Fill in the gaps with the verbs in the list.' Ro'yxat qiya harflarda: meet, play, watch, listen to, have, do, ride, wash, go, read. Ostida 10 qator, har birida oq to'rtburchak (bo'shliq) va so'zlar.
   b) 'Can you think of more nouns to go with the verbs above?'
2) 'Use phrases from Ex. 1a and say two things you' - ostida zinapoya shaklida oltita qator: 1 ... do every day. 2 ... do every weekend. 3 ... don't like doing. 4 ... hate doing. 5 ... don't mind doing. 6 ... like doing.
Pastda C surati - Yer sayyorasi fonida quyosh batareyali SUN'IY YO'LDOSh.

O'NG USTUN:
3) a) 'Look at the pictures and the title of the article. What is the Milky Way?'
   b) 'Which picture shows: a space shuttle in orbit [ ]; a space walk [ ]; a satellite [ ]; astronauts working with each other [ ]; the crew aboard a spaceship [ ]?'
   c) 'What do astronauts do every day while in orbit?'
4) (kassetа belgisi bilan) 'Listen and tick the word(s) you hear.' To'rtta gap, har birida ikki variant va katakcha. 1-gapda '6:41' varianti ALLAQAChON belgilangan (namuna).
• To'q sariq 'Reading' sarlavhasi.
5) 'Read the article and fill in the missing sentences, then explain the words in bold.' Uchta gap: a), b), c).
O'ng pastda D surati - ochiq kosmosda suzayotgan kosmonavt (skafandr, reaktiv qurilma).

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '12'.

⚠ 5-mashqdagi MAQOLA keyingi betda (13-bet).

⚠ SKAN OGOHLANTIRIShI: PDF faylida betlar tartibsiz - 12-betdan keyin darrov 15-bet keladi; 13 va 14-betlar 16-betdan keyin joylashgan.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the verbs in the list.
exercises.explanationUz:
KUNDALIK IShLAR - FE'L VA OT BIRIKMASI.

  ⚠ Bu - COLLOCATION mashqi: inglizchada
  qaysi fe'l qaysi ot bilan yuradi.

  ⚠ O'zbekchada bitta fe'l ('qilmoq')
  ko'p narsaga to'g'ri keladi, inglizchada
  esa har ot O'Z fe'lini talab qiladi.


⚠ ENG QIYIN UChTASI - 'DO', 'MAKE',
'HAVE':

  DO - ish, vazifa, uy yumushi
     do homework, do the washing-up,
     do the ironing, do the housework,
     do the shopping

  MAKE - biror narsa YaRATISh
     make a cake, make a mistake,
     make a noise, make friends

  HAVE - ovqat, tajriba, mashg'ulot
     have breakfast, have a shower,
     have a lesson, have a good time

  ⚠ 'do a mistake' - XATO.
  ⚠ 'make homework' - XATO.


⚠ 'GO' + -ING (mashg'ulotlar):

  go shopping, go dancing, go fishing,
  go swimming, go hiking, go skiing

  ⚠ Lekin 'go TO bed' - bu -ING emas,
  chunki 'bed' OT.
  ⚠ 'go to bed' da artikl YO'Q!


⚠ 'LISTEN TO' - PREDLOG ShART:

  'listen TO music' ✓
  'listen music' ✗

  ⚠ Lekin 'watch TV' - predlogsiz.
  ⚠ 'hear' bilan ham predlog yo'q:
  'I hear a noise.'


⚠ 'RIDE' va 'DRIVE':

  ride - ustiga MINIB boshqariladigan
     narsa: a bicycle, a motorbike,
     a horse
  drive - IChIGA kirib boshqariladigan
     narsa: a car, a bus, a lorry


⚠ 'WASH' va 'WASH UP':

  wash - yuvmoq (kir, mashina, yuz)
  do the washing-up - IDISh yuvmoq

  ⚠ Britaniyada 'do the washing-up',
  AQShda 'do the dishes'.
  ⚠ 9-bandda 'the dishes' bilan 'wash'
  ham ishlatilgan - ikkalasi to'g'ri.

exercises.instructionEn: Can you think of more nouns to go with the verbs above?
exercises.instructionUz: Yuqoridagi fe'llarga mos yana otlar o'ylab topa olasizmi?
exercises.explanationUz:
HAR FE'L UChUN YANA OTLAR.

  ⚠ Bu ro'yxatni kengaytirish - lug'atni
  eng tez o'stiradigan usul: yangi so'zni
  ALOHIDA emas, TANISh fe'l bilan
  BIRGA yodlaysiz.

points.en: play: football, the piano, chess, computer games
points.uz: o'ynamoq: futbol, pianino, shaxmat, kompyuter o'yinlari
points.noteUz:
⚠ Sport oldidan artikl YO'Q: 'play football'.
⚠ Cholg'u oldidan 'THE' ShART: 'play THE piano'.

points.en: ride: a horse, a bike, a scooter
points.noteUz:
⚠ Ustiga MINIB boshqariladigan narsalar.
⚠ Mashina uchun 'drive'.

points.en: go: swimming, jogging, skiing, camping, to school, to work
points.uz: bormoq: suzishga, yugurishga, chang'iga, sayohatga, maktabga, ishga

points.en: read: an e-mail, a text message, a story, a letter
points.uz: o'qimoq: elektron xat, SMS, hikoya, xat
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'read' - noto'g'ri fe'l: read - read - read,
lekin TALAFFUZI o'zgaradi: /riːd/ - /red/ - /red/.

points.en: meet: your teacher, new people, a friend at the station
points.uz: uchrashmoq: o'qituvchingiz, yangi odamlar, vokzalda do'sting bilan
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to meet' predlogsiz: 'meet my friend'
('meet with' - AQSh varianti).

points.en: watch: a match, a video, a DVD
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'watch' = uzoq va diqqat bilan ko'rmoq.
⚠ 'see a film' ham to'g'ri (kinoteatrda).

points.en: have: lunch, a bath, a rest, a party, a headache
points.uz: qilmoq: tushlik, vanna, dam, bazm; boshi og'rimoq
points.noteUz:
⚠ Bu iboralarda 'have' CONTINUOUS shaklda
ham bo'ladi: 'I'm having lunch.'

points.en: listen to: a CD, the teacher, a podcast
wash: your hands, the windows, the dog
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'wash your hands' - egalik olmoshi bilan
('wash the hands' emas).

points.en: do: the shopping, an exercise, a test, the cooking
points.uz: qilmoq: xarid, mashq, test, ovqat pishirish
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'do the shopping' (xarid qilish) va
'go shopping' (do'konga borish) - ikkalasi ham
to'g'ri, lekin ma'nosi biroz boshqa.

exercises.instructionEn: Use phrases from Ex. 1a and say two things you: 1 ... do every day. 2 ... do every weekend. 3 ... don't like doing. 4 ... hate doing. 5 ... don't mind doing. 6 ... like doing.
exercises.instructionUz: 1a mashqidagi iboralardan foydalanib, o'zingiz haqingizda ikkitadan narsa ayting: 1 ... har kuni qiladiganingiz. 2 ... har dam olish kunida qiladiganingiz. 3 ... yoqtirmaydiganingiz. 4 ... yomon ko'radiganingiz. 5 ... qarshi bo'lmaganingiz. 6 ... yoqtiradiganingiz.
exercises.explanationUz:
YOQTIRISh VA YOQTIRMASLIK.

  ⚠ ENG MUHIM QOIDA: bu fe'llardan
  keyin HAR DOIM -ING shakli keladi.

     like       + -ING
     don't like + -ING
     hate       + -ING
     don't mind + -ING
     enjoy      + -ING
     love       + -ING

  ⚠ 'I hate to do' ham uchraydi, lekin
  -ING tabiiyroq va kitob shuni
  so'rayapti.


⚠ KUChLILIK DARAJASI (kuchsizdan
kuchliga):

  hate          - yomon ko'raman
  don't like    - yoqtirmayman
  don't mind    - qarshi emasman
  like          - yoqtiraman
  love          - juda yaxshi ko'raman

  ⚠ 'don't mind' - o'rtada turadi:
  yoqmaydi ham, yoqadi ham emas -
  ParVO QILMAYMAN.


⚠ 'DON'T MIND' - DIQQAT:

  'I don't mind doing the washing-up.'
  = Idish yuvishga qarshi emasman.

  ⚠ 'Do you mind ...?' esa MULOYIM
  ILTIMOS: 'Do you mind closing the
  window?' = Derazani yopsangiz
  bo'ladimi?
  ⚠ Bunga javob: 'No, not at all.'
  ('No' - ROZILIK bildiradi!)


⚠ 'EVERY DAY' - AJRATIB YOZILADI:

  'I do it every day.' (ravish)
  ⚠ 'everyday' (birga) = SIFAT.
exercises.exampleEn: I have breakfast and do my homework every day.
exercises.exampleUz: Men har kuni nonushta qilaman va uy vazifamni bajaraman.
modelAnswers: I have breakfast and listen to music every day.
I play video games and meet friends every weekend.
I don't like doing the ironing or washing the car.
I hate doing the washing-up and getting up early.
I don't mind doing my homework or washing the dishes.
I like reading books and playing tennis.
modelAnswersUz: Men har kuni nonushta qilaman va musiqa tinglayman.
Men har dam olish kunida video o'yin o'ynayman va do'stlarim bilan uchrashaman.
Men dazmol qilishni va mashina yuvishni yoqtirmayman.
Men idish yuvishni va erta turishni yomon ko'raman.
Uy vazifamni bajarishga va idish yuvishga qarshi emasman.
Men kitob o'qishni va tennis o'ynashni yoqtiraman.

exercises.instructionEn: a) Look at the pictures and the title of the article. What is the Milky Way? b) Which picture shows: a space shuttle in orbit; a 'space walk'; a satellite; astronauts working with each other; the crew aboard a spaceship? c) What do astronauts do every day while in orbit?
exercises.instructionUz: a) Suratlarga va maqola sarlavhasiga qarang. Somon yo'li nima? b) Qaysi surat nimani ko'rsatadi: orbitadagi kosmik kema; 'kosmik sayr'; sun'iy yo'ldosh; bir-biriga yordam berayotgan kosmonavtlar; kemadagi ekipaj? c) Kosmonavtlar orbitada har kuni nima qiladi?
exercises.explanationUz:
MATNNI O'QIShDAN OLDIN TAXMIN QILISh.

  ⚠ Bu 'predicting' - o'qish ko'nikmasining
  muhim qismi: suratlarga va sarlavhaga
  qarab matn nima haqida ekanini
  oldindan bilish.


⚠ 'THE MILKY WAY':

  = SOMON YO'LI - bizning galaktikamiz.

  ⚠ So'zma-so'z: 'sutli yo'l'.
  Qadimgi yunon afsonasiga ko'ra bu -
  osmonga to'kilgan sut.

  ⚠ O'zbekchada 'Somon yo'li' (somon
  sochilgan yo'l).

  ⚠ HAR DOIM 'THE' bilan va KATTA
  harf bilan yoziladi.


SURATLAR:
  A - kosmik kema (space shuttle)
  B - kabinadagi ikki kosmonavt
  C - sun'iy yo'ldosh (satellite)
  D - ochiq kosmosdagi kosmonavt
  E - (13-betda) kemaning manipulyator
      qo'li yonidagi kosmonavt


⚠ KOSMIK SO'ZLAR:

  a space shuttle - qayta ishlatiladigan
     kosmik kema
  orbit - orbita ('IN orbit' - artiklsiz!)
  a space walk - ochiq kosmosga chiqish
  a satellite - sun'iy yo'ldosh
  a spaceship - kosmik kema
  a crew - ekipaj
  aboard - bort ustida
  Mission Control - uchish boshqaruv
     markazi

  ⚠ 'IN ORBIT' - artiklsiz turg'un ibora.
  ⚠ 'ABOARD a spaceship' - 'on board'
  ning qisqa shakli.

items.question: What is the Milky Way?
items.answer: It is the galaxy that our solar system is in.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'the Milky Way' = Somon yo'li galaktikasi.

⚠ HAR DOIM 'the' bilan va katta harf bilan.

items.prompt: Qaysi surat orbitadagi kosmik kemani ko'rsatadi?
items.question: Which picture shows a space shuttle in orbit?
items.whyUz:
⚠ A suratida kosmik kema yon tomondan.

⚠ 'IN orbit' - artiklsiz turg'un ibora.

items.question: Which picture shows a 'space walk'?
items.answer: Picture D (and picture E on page 13).
items.whyUz:
⚠ D suratida kosmonavt ochiq kosmosda suzmoqda.

⚠ 13-betdagi E surati ham kosmik sayrni
ko'rsatadi.

items.question: Which picture shows a satellite?
items.whyUz:
⚠ C suratida quyosh batareyali sun'iy yo'ldosh
Yer fonida.

⚠ 'a satellite' - imlosiga diqqat: ikkita 'l'.

items.prompt: Qaysi surat bir-biriga yordam berayotgan kosmonavtlarni ko'rsatadi?
items.question: Which picture shows astronauts working with each other?
items.whyUz:
⚠ B suratida IKKI kosmonavt birga ishlamoqda.

⚠ 'each other' = bir-biri.
⚠ Matnda: 'we have to work very closely and
help each other'.

items.question: Which picture shows the crew aboard a spaceship?
items.whyUz:
⚠ B - kema IChIDAGI ekipaj.

⚠ 'a crew' - JAMOA oti: bitta so'z, ko'p odam.
Britaniyada fe'l ko'plikda bo'lishi mumkin:
'the crew ARE working'.

items.prompt: Kosmonavtlar orbitada har kuni nima qiladi?
items.question: What do astronauts do every day while in orbit?
items.answer: They wash, have breakfast, work on projects, take photos, do space walks, eat, read and sleep.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Bu - TAXMIN savoli; aniq javob 13-betdagi
maqolada.

⚠ 'while in orbit' = orbitada bo'lganda
('while they are in orbit' ning qisqa shakli).

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and tick the word(s) you hear.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR 13-BETDAGI MAQOLADA BOR.

  ⚠ Kassetada shu maqola o'qiladi, shuning
  uchun mashqni AUDIOSIZ ham bajarish
  mumkin - matndan tekshiring.

  ⚠ 1-band kitobda ALLAQAChON
  belgilangan (namuna): 6:41.


⚠ 'CST' NIMA:

  = Central Standard Time
  = Markaziy standart vaqt (AQShning
    markaziy mintaqasi - Chikago).

  ⚠ Matnda: 'that's the same time that
  people in Chicago use'.

  ⚠ Kosmosda 'ertalab' va 'kechqurun'
  yo'q - shuning uchun ekipaj YERDAGI
  bir vaqt mintaqasiga qarab yashaydi.


⚠ SOATNI O'QISh:

  6:41 pm = 'six forty-one pm'
  ⚠ Yoki: 'nineteen minutes to seven'.

  ⚠ 'pm' = tushdan keyin (post meridiem)
  ⚠ 'am' = tushgacha (ante meridiem)


⚠ 'TWO SIX-HOUR' - DEFISGA DIQQAT:

  'two six-hour space walks'
  = ikkita olti soatlik kosmik sayr

  ⚠ 'six-hour' - defis bilan va HOUR
  BIRLIKDA ('six-hours' XATO), chunki
  u SIFAT vazifasida.

  ⚠ 'six two-hour' bo'lsa: oltita ikki
  soatlik sayr - butunlay boshqa ma'no!

items.textEn: 1  Mission Control wakes the crew up with music at exactly ___ pm CST.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Kitobda ALLAQAChON belgilangan - namuna.

⚠ Matnda: 'Mission Control wakes the crew up
with music at exactly 6:41pm CST'.

⚠ Matnda: "Washing isn't EASY in space."

⚠ DIQQAT: gapda INKOR bor. "isn't difficult"
teskari ma'no berardi.

items.textEn: 3  Each day there are also ___ space walks.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Matnda: 'Each day there are also TWO SIX-HOUR
space walks.'

⚠ IKKITA olti soatlik - oltita ikki soatlik emas!

items.textEn: 4  Sometimes we sit by the window and admire the ___ and the stars.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Matnda: 'we sit by the window and admire the
EARTH and the stars'.

⚠ 'the Earth' - sayyora nomi sifatida KATTA harf
va 'the' bilan.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the article and fill in the missing sentences, then explain the words in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Maqolani o'qing va yetishmayotgan gaplarni qo'ying, so'ng qalin harfli so'zlarni tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
YETIShMAYOTGAN GAPNI TOPISh.

  ⚠ Maqola 13-betda, unda uchta
  raqamlangan bo'shliq bor.


⚠ QANDAY TOPILADI - UCh QADAM:

  1) Bo'shliqdan OLDINGI gapni o'qing
  2) Bo'shliqdan KEYINGI gapni o'qing
  3) Ikkalasiga MANTIQAN bog'lanadigan
     gapni tanlang

  ⚠ BOG'LOVChI SO'ZLAR eng katta
  yordamchi:
     'For example' - oldin umumiy fikr
        bo'lishi kerak
     'so' - sabab va natija
     'In the evening' - vaqt ketma-ketligi


TAHLIL:

  1-bo'shliq:
     Oldin: 'The pieces of music are
        always different.'
     Javob (b): 'For example, they might
        wake up to a traditional Japanese
        song one day, and a new American
        rock song the next!'
     ⚠ 'For example' - oldingi umumiy
     fikrga MISOL.

  2-bo'shliq:
     Oldin: 'The crew take a short break
        for lunch...'
     Keyin: 'According to NASA, the crew's
        special meals are tasty...'
     Javob (c): 'They need a lot of energy,
        so they eat a lot of food.'
     ⚠ Mavzu - OVQAT.

  3-bo'shliq:
     Oldin: "it's not all work and no play
        aboard the space shuttle"
     Keyin: 'Most of us read and send our
        personal e-mail in this free time...'
     Javob (a): "In the 'evening' we all
        have a couple of hours to have
        dinner and relax."
     ⚠ Keyingi gapda 'THIS free time'
     deyilgan - demak oldin BO'Sh VAQT
     tilga olingan bo'lishi kerak.


⚠ 'ALL WORK AND NO PLAY':

  To'liq maqol: 'All work and no play
  makes Jack a dull boy.'
  = Faqat ishlab, dam olmagan odam
    zerikarli bo'lib qoladi.

  ⚠ Matn maqolning yarmini ishlatgan -
  ingliz o'quvchisi davomini biladi.
wordList: a) In the 'evening' we all have a couple of hours to have dinner and relax.
b) For example, they might wake up to a traditional Japanese song one day, and a new American rock song the next!
c) They need a lot of energy, so they eat a lot of food.

items.sentence: The pieces of music are always different. ___ After that, they have a couple of hours to wash, have breakfast and get the 'morning' messages from Mission Control.
items.answer: b) For example, they might wake up to a traditional Japanese song one day, and a new American rock song the next!
items.uz: Musiqa asarlari har doim boshqacha. ___ Shundan keyin ularda yuvinish, nonushta qilish va Boshqaruv markazidan 'ertalabki' xabarlarni olish uchun bir necha soat bo'ladi.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'For example' - oldingi umumiy fikrga MISOL.

⚠ Oldingi gap: 'musiqa har doim boshqacha' -
keyin misol keladi: yapon qo'shig'i, amerika
rok qo'shig'i.

items.sentence: The crew take a short break for lunch during the 'afternoon'. ___ According to NASA, the crew's special meals are 'tasty and very good for them'.
items.answer: c) They need a lot of energy, so they eat a lot of food.
items.uz: Ekipaj 'tushdan keyin' tushlik uchun qisqa tanaffus qiladi. ___ NASA ma'lumotiga ko'ra, ekipajning maxsus taomlari 'mazali va ular uchun juda foydali'.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Oldingi va keyingi gap ham OVQAT haqida -
demak bo'shliqqa ham ovqat haqidagi gap kerak.

⚠ 'so' - sabab va natija bog'lovchisi.

items.sentence: "Fortunately, it's not all work and no play aboard the space shuttle," says Leroy. "___ Most of us read and send our personal e-mail in this free time..."
items.answer: a) In the 'evening' we all have a couple of hours to have dinner and relax.
items.uz: "Yaxshiyamki, kosmik kemada faqat ish emas," - deydi Leroy. "___ Ko'pchiligimiz shu bo'sh vaqtda shaxsiy elektron xatlarimizni o'qiymiz va yuboramiz..."
items.whyUz:
⚠ Keyingi gapda 'in THIS free time' deyilgan -
demak bo'shliqda BO'Sh VAQT tilga olingan
bo'lishi kerak.

⚠ 'a couple of hours' = bir-ikki soat.

patterns.exampleEn: I have breakfast and do my homework every day.

patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ PRESENT SIMPLE - odat.
⚠ 'every day' AJRATIB yoziladi.

patterns.formula: I like / don't like / hate / don't mind [-ING].
patterns.exampleEn: I don't mind doing the washing-up, but I hate doing the ironing.

patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Bu fe'llardan keyin HAR DOIM -ING.
⚠ Kuchlilik: hate < don't like < don't mind <
like < love.

patterns.exampleEn: Which picture shows a satellite? - Picture C.
patterns.exampleUz: Qaysi surat sun'iy yo'ldoshni ko'rsatadi? - C surati.

patterns.exampleEn: Each day there are two six-hour space walks.
patterns.exampleUz: Har kuni ikkita olti soatlik kosmik sayr bo'ladi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'six-hour' - DEFIS bilan va HOUR BIRLIKDA,
chunki u sifat vazifasida.
⚠ 'six-hours' - XATO.

groups.explanationUz: 1a mashqidagi 10-band: 'do the washing-up, the ironing, the housework'.
Ingliz tilida eng ko'p xato qilinadigan uchlik.

items.derived: make a cake, make a mistake
